All 21 frozen trigger names currently resolve and their enabled-state text matches the frozen values.

sql_log.sql: with p0 as (select payload from public.lf_eventos where id=20161), c as (select x from p0,jsonb_array_elements(payload->'sql_callers') x) select count(*) callers, count(*) filter(where coalesce(x->>'caller','')='') missing_caller, count(distinct x->>'caller') distinct_callers, count(*) filter(where coalesce(x->>'definition_md5','')='') missing_definition_md5 from c;

with p0 as (select payload from public.lf_eventos where id=20161), c as (select x->>'caller' fqn,x->>'definition_md5' old_md5 from p0,jsonb_array_elements(payload->'sql_callers') x), cur as (select n.nspname||'.'||p.proname fqn,p.oid,md5(p.prosrc) cur_md5 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace) select count(*) p0_total,count(*) filter(where cur.fqn is not null) current_resolved,count(*) filter(where cur.cur_md5=c.old_md5) md5_prosrc_equal,count(*) filter(where cur.fqn is not null and cur.cur_md5<>c.old_md5) md5_prosrc_changed,count(*) filter(where cur.fqn is null) absent from c left join cur using(fqn);

select count(*) objects,count(distinct regexp_replace(proname,'(_v[0-9]+|_cached_v[0-9]+|_ctx)$','','g')) normalized_families,count(*) filter(where cnt>1) multi_member_families from (select p.proname,count(*) over(partition by regexp_replace(p.proname,'(_v[0-9]+|_cached_v[0-9]+|_ctx)$','','g')) cnt from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='programacion' and (p.proname ilike '%input_governance%' or p.proname ilike '%input_readiness%' or p.proname ilike '%input_run%')) s;

with p0 as (select payload from public.lf_eventos where id=20161), tr as (select x->>'trigger' trigger_name,x->>'table' table_name,x->>'function' function_name,x->>'enabled' enabled from p0,jsonb_array_elements(payload->'trigger_bindings') x) select count(*) p0_triggers,count(*) filter(where t.oid is not null) current_trigger_name_matches,count(*) filter(where t.tgenabled::text=tr.enabled) enabled_matches from tr left join pg_trigger t on t.tgname=tr.trigger_name and not t.tgisinternal;
